newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA MAKE THREE CHANGES FOR ONE-DAYERS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA MAKE THREE CHANGES FOR ONE-DAYERS.

text.p: Australia on Sunday made three changes to their squad for the forthcoming one-day series against South Africa.
All-rounders Stuart Law and Michael DiVenuto as well as left arm seamer Brendon Julian will join the squad, team management said.

They will replace specialist batsmen Matthew Hayden, Matthew Elliott and Justin Langer who will return home after the conclusion of the third and final test which is scheduled to end in Pretoria on Tuesday. Australia lead the test series 2-0.
South Africa are due to announce their squad on Monday.
The seven-match one-day series begins in East London on Saturday.

Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Stuart Law, Michael DiVenuto, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Glenn McGrath, Jason Gillespie, Paul Reiffel, Andrew Bichel, Brendon Julian.
